topic: State of Art in Modeling and Modeling Deployment for the Process and Pharma Industries; from Advanced Simulations to Web Apps
title: State of Art in Modeling and Modeling Deployment for the Process and Pharma Industries; from Advanced Simulations to Web Apps
session_title: Sponsored Technology Workshop: State of Art in Modeling and Modeling Deployment for the Process and Pharma Industries; from Advanced Simulations to Web Apps
abstract: Taking the drug manufacturing process as an example, the presentation will highlight the breadth and value of M&S when it comes to manufacturing. Starting from upstream processes like mixing and clean-in-place, to downstream processes like chromatography, separation, and fill/finish, and ending with packaging and shipping, the value of M&S will be highlighted. Furthermore, the concept of simulation democratization will be introduced where advanced simulations will be made accessible to plant/manufacturing engineers using simple to use Web-Apps."
